name: docling
description: IBM's Docling: the best layout and table understanding for hard PDFs (multi-column papers, complex tables), with its own models. Used for a PDF when LOKI_DOCLING=1 or LOKI_PDF_ENGINE=docling. Large: PyTorch and models, about 2 GB; slow without a GPU.
install: pip install docling (the Install button does it; about 2 GB with PyTorch)
notice: Big download. The documents add-on is enough for most PDFs.
